sentences.zh: 这里是《隐藏的大脑》节目。

sentences.en: People in romantic relationships often share things in common.
sentences.zh: 恋爱中的人们往往有共同点。

sentences.en: A love with the same sports team, maybe the same religion, sometimes a common profession.
sentences.zh: 比如支持同一支运动队，可能有相同的宗教信仰，有时是共同的职业。

sentences.en: But for some couples, the similarities go further.
sentences.zh: 但对一些情侣来说，相似之处远不止于此。

sentences.en: The girl that I'm dating now, we have the same birthday, which is kind of cool.
sentences.zh: 我现在的女朋友和我是同一天生日，这挺酷的。

sentences.en: My fiancé Israel and I have the same birthday, which is something we discovered on our second date.
sentences.zh: 我和我的未婚夫以色列是同一天生日，这是我们在第二次约会时发现的。

sentences.en: You could say this isn't so surprising.
sentences.zh: 你可能会说这并不令人惊讶。

sentences.en: There are lots of people in the world, and sooner or later,
sentences.zh: 世界上有很多人，迟早有一天，

sentences.en: some people are going to get together with others who happen to have the same birthday.
sentences.zh: 有些人会和恰好在同一天生日的人走到一起。

sentences.en: But there's evidence this may be more than just a coincidence.
sentences.zh: 但有证据表明，这可能不仅仅是巧合。

sentences.en: Having a common birthday seems to actually draw people closer to one another.
sentences.zh: 拥有共同的生日似乎真的能让人们更加亲近。

sentences.en: When I first went to a new hairstylist, we found out that we had the same birthday,
sentences.zh: 当我第一次去一位新的发型师那里时，我们发现我们是同一天生日，

sentences.en: and we called each other birthday twins.
sentences.zh: 我们互称对方为“生日双胞胎”。

sentences.en: And I wound up going to that hairstylist for years, even after she switched salons,
sentences.zh: 结果我找那位发型师剪了多年头发，即使在她换了沙龙之后，
甚至在我们搬家之后也是如此。

sentences.en: I would drive 40 minutes to go get my hair cut by her.
sentences.zh: 我愿意开车40分钟去找她剪头发。

sentences.en: Some people see so much significance in shared birthdays, or even shared numbers in two birthdays,
sentences.zh: 有些人认为共同的生日，甚至两个生日中共享的数字意义重大，

sentences.en: that they select dates for important events based on those patterns.
sentences.zh: 以至于他们会根据这些模式来选择重要事件的日期。

sentences.en: My friend and I share the same birthday, July 6th, and we are also married on that day.
sentences.zh: 我和我的朋友是同一天生日，7月6日，我们也是在那一天结婚的。

sentences.en: My birthday is October 27th, and with my first husband, his birthday was September 27th,
sentences.zh: 我的生日是10月27日，我第一任丈夫的生日是9月27日，

sentences.en: and we had the opportunity to get married on August 27th.
sentences.zh: 我们有机会在8月27日结婚。

sentences.en: The woman you just heard, Janetta Cravens from Oklahoma City,
sentences.zh: 你刚才听到的那位女士，来自俄克拉荷马城的珍妮塔·克雷文斯，

sentences.en: says her love for people with the same birthday extends beyond her love life.
sentences.zh: 说她对同一天生日的人的喜爱，延伸到了她的爱情生活之外。

sentences.en: October 27th is also Teddy Roosevelt's birthday, and so I've always felt a little affinity for him and for his leadership.
sentences.zh: 10月27日也是西奥多·罗斯福的生日，所以我一直对他和他的领导力有一种亲近感。

sentences.en: Shared birthdays, in fact, aren't the only thing that draw people closer to one another.
sentences.zh: 事实上，共同的生日并不是唯一能让人们更加亲近的事情。

sentences.en: Janetta also finds herself drawn to people who happen to have the same name.
sentences.zh: 珍妮塔还发现自己会被那些恰好有相同名字的人所吸引。

sentences.en: When I meet another Janetta, there's an automatic, like, oh my gosh, I can't believe we have the same name.
sentences.zh: 当我遇到另一个珍妮塔时，会有一种自动的反应，比如，天哪，真不敢相信我们名字一样。

sentences.en: And then it happens to be that we have the same spelling.

sentences.zh: 但我能说出她们是谁，而且我感到了一种自动的亲缘关系。

sentences.en: These unexpected connections with strangers can be lovely moments.
sentences.zh: 这些与陌生人之间意想不到的联系可能是美好的时刻。

sentences.en: But there's something else at work, too.

sentences.en: In Greek mythology, the hunter Narcissus was so enamored of his own beauty
sentences.zh: 在希腊神话中，猎人纳西索斯对自己的美貌如此着迷，

sentences.en: that he fell in love with a reflection of himself.
sentences.zh: 以至于他爱上了自己的倒影。

sentences.en: Modern psychology shows that we all have a little bit of Narcissus in us.
sentences.zh: 现代心理学表明，我们每个人内心深处都有点纳西索斯的影子。

sentences.en: Most of us like people who remind us of ourselves,

sentences.zh: 大多数时候，这种自恋是有趣且无害的，

sentences.zh: 甚至可能是有益的，是良好自尊心的标志。

or with people who remind us of ourselves can be a real problem.
